what.title: A house that runs itself, the way you like it
what.body: A smart home is a house equipped with technology that allows you to control and automate everyday functions. Lights, air conditioning, security cameras and door locks can be managed through a smartphone or voice commands. It saves time, improves comfort, increases safety and reduces energy consumption by using devices more efficiently.
